description: This file contains unit tests for client connection events in an Orleans-based distributed system. The tests verify behaviors such as cluster disconnection handling and gateway count change notifications.

classes.name: ClientConnectionEventTests
classes.description: A test class containing methods to verify client connection and disconnection events in an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: EventSendWhenDisconnectedFromCluster
methods.description: Tests that the client detects cluster disconnection and triggers the connection lost handler.

methods.name: GatewayChangedEventSentOnDisconnectAndReconnect
methods.description: Tests that the client receives gateway count change events during disconnect and reconnection sequences.
